# Sinter

> Sinter is an agentless configuration-management tool for Linux, built in
> Rust. Recipes are YAML or TOML; execution is local or over SSH. Current
> release: v0.4.1 (Linux x86_64).

## Documentation

- [Documentation home (English)](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/en/)
- [ドキュメント ホーム (日本語)](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/ja/)
- [Installation](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/en/getting-started/installation/)
- [Supported platforms](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/en/compatibility/platforms/)
- [CLI reference](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/en/reference/cli/)
- [Resource reference](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/en/reference/resources/)

## Machine-readable

- [Documentation WebMCP](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/en/reference/webmcp/): read-only documentation lookup tools the site exposes to WebMCP-capable browsers
- [WebMCP data — English](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/webmcp/en.json): machine-readable Sinter documentation data used by the site's WebMCP tool surface
- [WebMCP data — 日本語](https://sinter.fulltrust.co.jp/webmcp/ja.json)
